resources.string: On the computer, start Agent Workspace with --host 0.0.0.0 and open Settings → Connect a phone.
Shown under Settings → Connect a phone
Scan the QR code from Settings → Connect a phone
This QR code is not an Agent Workspace code.
Enter the IP address and a port between 1 and 65535.
Cannot reach %1$s (%2$s). Is the computer on the same Wi-Fi, started with --host 0.0.0.0, and is the port open in its firewall?
The server refused the token. Scan the QR code again or copy the token from Settings → Connect a phone.
Press back again to change the server
Agent Workspace %1$s is out (you have %2$s). Download the new APK and open it to install the update.
